project: POS System - VPS Deployment Restructure for Oracle Cloud Always Free
scope: Restructure project for multi-VM deployment on Oracle Cloud Always Free Tier
principle: 100% Free tier only, production-ready architecture, easy to go public later

oracle_cloud_always_free_resources.note: These are LIFETIME FREE resources from Oracle Cloud — never expire

arm_instances.note: Can split into up to 4 VMs or use as 1 large VM

amd_instances.total: 2 VMs x (1/8 OCPU + 1 GB RAM) AMD Micro
amd_instances.note: Very limited — use for lightweight tasks only

storage.note: Object Storage replaces Cloudflare R2 for image/file storage

database.note: Oracle Autonomous DB is managed — auto-patching, auto-backup. Supports SQL (Oracle dialect or APEX). Alternative: self-host PostgreSQL on VM

vm_allocation_plan.strategy: Split Ampere A1 (4 OCPU + 24 GB) into 3 VMs + use 1 AMD Micro

vms.name: vm-frontend
vms.future_public: This VM serves the public website

vms.name: vm-backend
vms.public_ip: Yes (reserved, but behind LB in future)
services: OCR processing (Gemini API / Ollama if RAM allows)
Queue (p-queue in-process, upgrade to BullMQ + Redis later)
vms.security: Only accessible from vm-frontend and vm-lb (not public directly in future)

vms.name: vm-database
services: Automated backup via pg_dump → Object Storage
vms.security: Only accessible from vm-backend via private subnet

vms.name: vm-monitor
services: WireGuard VPN (Secure access to private subnets)
vms.security: Acts as a jump-box/gateway for admin tasks
